title: Microsoft SDL 5.2 — structured records the process prescribes (DERIVED)
description: DERIVED by this library from SDL 5.2 prose and tables; Microsoft publishes no schema. Enumerations are verbatim value names from the cited sections.

SecurityBugCause.description: Appendix B, Security Bug Cause (values); descriptions in normative.md

SecurityBugEffect.description: Appendix B, Security Bug Effect (STRIDE plus Not a Security Bug and Attack Surface Reduction)

Severity.x-source: Appendix N security bug bar; Appendix M privacy bug bar; LOB pre-production severity table

PrivacyImpactRating.description: P1 High Privacy Risk, P2 Moderate Privacy Risk, P3 Low Privacy Risk
PrivacyImpactRating.x-source: Phase One > Cost Analysis > Privacy Requirements

SecurityWorkItem.description: A security bug/work item as the tracking tool must record it (Phase One > Project Inception; Appendix B).

security_bug_effect.description: 'should be set to one or more of the following STRIDE values'

security_bug_cause.description: 'should be mandatory if Security Bug Effect is anything other than Not a Security Bug'

bug_bar_severity.description: 'The project’s bug tracking system must accommodate the bug bar ranking value recorded with each bug.'

access.const: project team and security advisors only
access.description: 'limit access to bugs with security implications to the project team and security advisors only'

exceptions.description: identified exceptions (Passed FSR with exceptions); to be logged and corrected in the next release

security_score.description: online services/LOB: 'required to have a security score of B or above' (letter scale beyond B INFERRED)

AgileRequirementRow.x-source: Appendices P, Q, R table header
